description: Preserve original topic-specific conversation content. Apply only exact source-confirmed ES A1 grammar or duplicate corrections. No generic support replacement. Three further exact A1 cross-station duplicate corrections were added after the complete 21-card source comparison.

patches.original: ¿Qué hace que una casa sea buena para una persona?
patches.replacement: ¿Qué necesita una persona en su casa?
patches.reason: A1: avoid causative subjunctive; same basic housing focus.

patches.original: ¿Qué hace que una casa sea segura y cómoda?
patches.replacement: ¿Cómo es una casa segura y cómoda?
patches.reason: A1: remove causative subjunctive without changing the topic.

patches.original: ¿Qué hace que alguien sea un buen amigo?
patches.reason: A1: use common present tense rather than subjunctive.

patches.replacement: ¿Tu instituto ideal es grande o pequeño?
patches.reason: Resolve exact duplication between real and ideal school stations with A1 wording.

patches.replacement: ¿Tu amigo está bien o está enfermo?
patches.reason: Original duplicates the main question of station 3; a short A1 question instead.

patches.original: Was sagst du, wenn du krank bist?
patches.replacement: Ist dein Freund krank oder gesund?
patches.reason: Original duplicates the main question of station 3; short A1 contrast instead.

patches.replacement: Il y a combien de personnes dans ta famille imaginaire ?
patches.reason: Original duplicates the main question of station 1; count people in the imagined family instead.
